messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to venlafaxine: hives; difficult breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Tell your doctor right away if you have new or sudden changes in mood or behavior, including new or worse depression or anxiety, panic attacks, trouble sleeping, or if you feel impulsive, irritable, agitated, hostile, aggressive, restless, more active or talkative, or have thoughts about suicide or hurting yourself.
Venlafaxine may cause serious side effects. Call your doctor at once if you have:
- blurred vision, eye pain or redness, seeing halos around lights;
- cough, chest tightness, trouble breathing;
- a seizure (convulsions);
- unusual bleeding - nosebleeds, bleeding gums, abnormal vaginal bleeding, any bleeding that will not stop;
- low blood sodium - headache, confusion, problems with thinking or memory, weakness, feeling unsteady; or
- severe nervous system reaction - very stiff (rigid) muscles, high fever, sweating, confusion, fast or uneven heartbeats, tremors, feeling like you might pass out.
Triplet: ["venlafaxine", "has side effect symptom", "swelling of lips"]

The relation 'has side effect symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the specific symptom or manifestation as an adverse effect.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'may require monitoring for': The subject drug may require close observation for the adverse effect or condition specified by the object entity.
